reviews.review_msg: Disappointing. My friend and I faced scrutiny for permitted technology use, while others engaging in similar behaviour appeared unaffected. Unexpected participation criticism came at semester's end. When I requested evidence, I received reflection questions instead of answers. This raised serious concerns about consistency and transparency. Avoid!!

Kailyn is an amazing professor. She grades super fast. Her assignments, quizzes, exams are super easy to understand. She is reachable outside of school hours and is very good and efficient at responding. She makes sure all her students are getting what they need and make sure everyone gets the help they need! I would definitely want her again!
Kailyn is enthusiastic and a great prof. She cares about the success of her students. I particularly like her efficiency in giving timely personalized feedback.
